Title: Generally Available: Support for Mongo 8.0 on vCore-based Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB

Body.Content:
You can now use MongoDB version 8.0 on vCore-based Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB. This release provides access to the latest MongoDB features, helping you build and manage your applications more efficiently. 

Learn more.
